A P PE N D I X  17
Adjustment of Desirable Body Weight 
for Amputees
The percentages listed here are estimates because body propor-
tions vary in individuals. Use of these percentages provides an 
approximation of desirable body weight, which is more accurate 
than a comparison with the standards for adults without ampu-
tations. Ideal body weight (IBW) must be adjusted downward to 
compensate for missing limbs or paralysis. It is estimated that 
5% to 10% should be subtracted from IBW for a paraplegic and 
from 10% to 15% subtracted for a tetraplegic (quadriplegic.)
